scripts.test: bun test components/book-preview components/book-preview-demo components/promotions lib
scripts.registry:build: npx -y shadcn@4.21.0 build && npx -y shadcn@4.21.0 build registry-pro.json -o registry-pro/r
scripts.registry:check: npm run registry:build && git diff --exit-code --stat public/r registry-pro registry.json registry-pro.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.test:visual: docker run --rm --network host --ipc=host -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CI=1 -e E2E_BASE_URL="${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3400}" -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual
scripts.test:visual:update: docker run --rm --network host --ipc=host -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CI=1 -e E2E_BASE_URL="${E2E_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3400}" -v "$PWD":/work -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.63.0-noble npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots
